@everyone CHARITY STREAM IS SAT NOV 21 🥫

posting this way earlier than last year bc last year half of yall found out the day of and we ended at $212. not this time lol

**the details**
📅 saturday nov 21, 10am to 10pm (12 hrs)
💚 all of it goes to the Linden Community Pantry
🔗 lindenpantry.example/mrkz
the link goes straight to the pantry, nothing gets taken off

**why this one**
the pantry is feeding around 340 families a week right now and Denise (she runs it) says the shelves are the lowest she's seen before thanksgiving. through their wholesale partner every $1 turns into about 4 lbs of food. so $3 is like 12 lbs. it really does add up

**goal: $600**
and rook is matching the first $100 people donate, so early donations count double 👀

**incentives** (shoutout jellybean)
💸 $100 = i play a full round with the controller upside down
💸 $250 = chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
💸 $400 = 1 hr of only chat picked songs, no skipping
💸 $600 = i vlog a grocery pickup the pantry sets up so you can see where the money went

**what we're playing**
first half is community lobbies, anyone can join, i'll drop the code. second half chat votes a new game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps, larry i promise

**no card? you can still help fr**
• drop canned or boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry's side door (saturdays 9 to 1)
• share the link with family or anyone who'd chip in
• just show up, hang in chat, join the lobbies. more ppl watching = more ppl donating

and if you can't give anything that's completely fine, no one's keeping track. just come hang

also i know some ppl think charity streams are kinda cringe and honestly fair, i get it lol. but the money goes straight to the pantry, not me, and if we get to $250 you get to pick what color my hair is. you get a show out of it at least

this is the only @everyone i'm sending so turn notifs on for the 21st. pinning this 📌
